fact: A Tunisian expert says existing data centres are general cloud and hosting rather than GPU clusters sized to train large AI models, that Tunisia does not control initial training of large language models, and that a supercomputer was installed at the Centre de Calcul El Khawarizmi in July 2026.
title: L'Intelligence artificielle en Tunisie: Du potentiel à la maîtrise, le défi du passage à l'échelle
